title: Operational Evaluation of Blockchain Monitoring Pipelines under Alert Budgets and Delayed Feedback
target: Journal of Systems and Software; ordinary Research Article

time_model.unknown_historical_observed_time: null; never substitute block timestamp as observed fact
time_model.availability_rule: Features and labels may influence a decision only after their declared availability time.
time_model.event_order_rule: Use validated chain/block/transaction/log or trace order; unresolved ties remain explicit.
time_model.cross_chain_rule: Use only already observed messages; watermark and waiting rules must be specified before evaluation.
time_model.finality_policy: to_be_frozen; reorg tests required only if non-finalized blocks are supported

evm.status: proposed; freeze after volume pilot and before method comparisons
evm.unit: emitted notification after causal grouping and suppression
evm.hard_limit: causal admission mechanism required; historical quantile alone is insufficient
evm.grouping: first notification immediate; suppress related later triggers by a predeclared rule

elliptic.zero_delay_order: predict and record decision before revealing label

calibration.evm_models: fixed domain rules and suitable unsupervised methods; supervised methods only with independent eligible training data
calibration.retraining_calibration: Separate available temporal window excluded from fitting the new model.
calibration.old_model_scores_for_new_model: not automatic; requires separately defined procedure
calibration.insufficient_positives_fallback: Retain the entire active model/threshold pair; scheduling/provenance utility implemented, full-study class minima still to be frozen.
calibration.feedback_assumption: All historically labelled examples become available after the declared delay; selective alert-only feedback is outside the minimum claim.
calibration.elliptic_delay_convention_draft: Prediction and decision for step t precede label release. Label from step s with integer delay d is released after step s+d and may first affect prediction s+d+1. Initial labelled development history and validation availability must be declared separately. Implement an explicit queue; do not reuse M2 known_upto=t-DELAY+1 for a d=0 sweep.

temporal_calibration_implementation.window: latest four available source steps containing known labels; excluded from fitting
temporal_calibration_implementation.activation: strictly increasing successful prediction steps; explicit optional initial activation step

data.false_alarm_estimation: requires adjudication of alerts, complete or sampled with known inclusion probabilities
data.previous_elliptic_steps_35_49_status: development/exploratory re-evaluation; not a new untouched external test
data.candidate_exposure_summary: Euler and Beanstalk have catalog/curation exposure (L2), not positive K4 evaluation use in the checked scope; BSC L0 only in checked sources. All remain ineligible pending complete case requirements.

pilot.scope: one ordinary day and one intensive fragment; one detector and two modes
pilot.purpose: feasibility and implementation correctness, not confirmatory scientific evidence
pilot.implementation_scope: Original header pilot plus separately configured Euler core event-log pilot; no receipts/traces, learned detector, actual adaptive fitting, cross-chain features or incident recall.
pilot.timing_interpretation: Local file read/decode/core/write measured. x1 and compressed arrival schedules use a virtual FIFO clock with measured service costs; no wall-clock pacing, real network or historical observation latency is claimed.
pilot.selection: One date chosen in advance, 2024-03-04 UTC; intensive hour is the maximum sum of transaction_count within that same date, earliest hour breaks ties. Workload-only exploratory selection; not an independent incident.
pilot.historical_finality: Offline canonical archive assumption; no live finality observation and no numerical confirmation delay imposed. Reorg handling unsupported.
pilot.recovery_scope: ReplayState snapshot round-trip and deterministic log-replay tests; no external notification delivery guarantee or transactional durable outbox claim.

event_log_extension.population_day: Euler V1 core all-topic emitter, 2023-03-01 UTC
event_log_extension.completeness: enumerated AWS partition; not independent full-receipt verification

storage.existing_run_all_sh: do not invoke without adaptation; it deletes and rewrites fixed *_v1 folders
storage.third_party_raw_data_and_labels: redistribute only when permitted by applicable licence

freeze_blockers: external case eligibility and exact scope

changes: Explicitly distinguish virtual FIFO queue experiments from paced replay and real end-to-end latency.
Do not reconstruct block hashes from the old cache: reacquire original upstream block-header partition.
Document old M2 delay convention and d=0 incompatibility.
Full experiment grid remains draft and unexecuted.

change_log.scope: v0.3 protocol-event feasibility and delayed-feedback implementation
changes: Completed bounded Euler all-topic event acquisition and six real-input replay cells; source and decision logs independently audited.
Recorded prior candidate exposure rather than describing previously curated cases as untouched.
Implemented prediction-before-release queue, separate temporal calibration plans and whole-pair fallback; no model fitting or full scientific grid.
Added strict activation-step guard against stale model updates.
Distinguished full scanned address population from retained payload size, and measured preparation cost from local replay and virtual queueing.
